summary.en: Tokyo-based seed/early-stage deep-tech and life-science VC founded 2014, with ~$325M under management across four funds and offices in Japan and India. Runs BRAVE, described as Japan's largest deep-tech accelerator (Beyond BioLAB TOKYO wet lab, up to ¥10M per team), having invested in 89 companies as of Nov 2025.
summary.local: 2014年設立、東京・日本橋拠点のシード・アーリー期ディープテック／ライフサイエンスVC。4ファンドで約3.25億ドルを運用し、日本とインドに拠点。国内最大級のディープテックアクセラレーター「BRAVE」（Beyond BioLAB TOKYO、1チーム最大1,000万円）を運営し、2025年11月時点で89社に投資。

summary.en: Japanese-founded fund manager (LINK-J member), headquartered in Singapore as the investment arm of AAIC Holdings, established 2013. Manages two Africa healthcare funds (AHF1 from 2017, AHF2 from 2022) totaling US$87 million (~¥13 billion), having invested in 47 companies as of July 2025 across 13 African countries.
